title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-02 Noether record: Spanish and Japanese through Paper 06 complete
description:
Dedicated Emmy Noether record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. The top-level PDFs expose source-checkable German modern LaTeX, English high-fidelity translations, and current multilingual pilot translations.

Status at a glance. [##########] numbered-paper German/English stream: Papers 1-43 complete and audited; [#####-----] multilingual stream: Paper 01 pilots in Spanish, Japanese, and French, Paper 02 through sections before 7 in Spanish/Japanese, complete Paper 02 in French, and Spanish/Japanese cumulative readers through Paper 06 complete; [##########] source/artifact preservation: TeX, source-scan witnesses, audit notes, glossary deltas, and reusable methodology notes are preserved in ZIP artifacts.

Latest update. Completed Paper 06 in the Spanish/Japanese multilingual lane, including cumulative TeX/PDF through Paper 06, standalone Paper 06 sections 7-15 readers, German source and English control excerpts, source-scan witness, render checks, glossary delta, and cumulative methodology/special-character notes.
notes: Latest update completes Paper 06 in the Spanish/Japanese multilingual lane and adds reusable methodology, glossary, special-character, and notation aids for future multilingual Noether translations.
